correctness.rationale: Fourier conjugation gives projector entries psi((a+b)k) h(al) conjugate(h(bl)). Translation character orthogonality separates q disjoint operator-coordinate blocks; diagonal J+(|z|^2-1)I has rank q-1 or 1 because constant eigenvalue q-2+|z|^2>0. In each nonzero block, x->x+1 pairs q-2 columns. Paired sum columns have rank s for Re z!=1 and 1 otherwise; differences contribute s exactly when Im z!=0, and the subspaces are disjoint. This proves R=d+(q-1)r for all n>=2 and z complex; direct full-projector modular ranks at q=4,8,16 and five test windows agree. Finite checks alone are not the proof; no singular-value theorem follows.

value.rationale: Full complex matrix recovery is a central structural question for Fourier and finite group frames. The exact rank stratification gives a natural complete parameter classification of one-frequency perturbation windows on an entire characteristic-two tower, identifies the exceptional q=4 phase locus, supplies a universal explicit recovery window z=2+i, and quantifies precisely how a real seed loses half the available matrix coordinates. These are exact structural outcomes with direct consequences for reconstructing all matrices and signal phases, not an arbitrary finite table.
